title: API reference format validation error message is unclear
description: When an agent provides an incomplete API reference (e.g., `jentic-test/test-api` instead of `jentic-test/test-api/1.0.0`), the error message says 'expected vendor/name/version' but doesn't show what the agent provided or suggest how to find the correct version.
expected_behavior: Error message should either: (a) auto-complete if only one version exists, or (b) suggest running `jentic apis list` to find the correct full reference.
actual_behavior: Error: invalid API reference "jentic-test/test-api"; expected vendor/name/version
evidence: Agent received error and had to manually discover the correct format

title: Access request command accepts incorrect action values without clear guidance
description: The access request API rejected the action value 'create' with a validation error, but the error message was truncated and didn't clearly explain the valid options until the agent tried `--help`.
reproduction_steps: Attempt `jentic access request` with an invalid action parameter
expected_behavior: Error message should clearly state: 'Valid actions are: bind, grant. You provided: create.'
actual_behavior: Error message was truncated JSON with validation details that required parsing to understand.
evidence: Exit code 1 with truncated error: error: http 422: {"detail":[{"type":"literal_error","loc":["body","items",0,"action"],"msg":"Input should be 'bind' or 'grant'","input":"create"...
